Components.pros: Cost-effective, scalable object store
Components.cons: Requires careful data transformation and processing
Components.design: Use S3 as an object store for storing raw sensor data from camera, lidar, and radar sources. Utilize Kinesis Data Firehose to process and transform the data into a standardized format.
Components.details: S3 provides cost-effective and scalable storage for large amounts of sensor data. Kinesis Data Firehose automates data transformation and processing, ensuring that data is in a consistent format for further processing.

Components.pros: Automated data transformation and processing
Components.cons: Requires expertise in data integration and processing
Components.design: Use Kinesis Data Firehose to process and transform sensor data from camera, lidar, and radar sources. This ensures that data is in a consistent format for further processing.
Components.details: Kinesis Data Firehose automates data transformation and processing, reducing the need for manual data integration and processing.
